items.exampleEn: Good sense prevailed, and the two neighbors stopped arguing.

items.exampleEn: The breakdown of the bus made us late for work.

items.exampleEn: The film tells the story of a boy who must follow his destiny.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影講述一個男孩必須追隨自己命運的故事。

items.exampleEn: Farmers are worried about an outbreak of disease among their pigs.

items.exampleEn: Cheap flights have increased the mobility of young people.
items.exampleZh: 便宜的機票提高了年輕人的移動能力。

items.exampleEn: We noticed the emergence of a new cafe culture in our town.
items.exampleZh: 我們注意到鎮上興起了一股新的咖啡館文化。

items.exampleEn: Adverse weather delayed several flights this morning.
items.exampleZh: 今天早上惡劣的天氣讓好幾班飛機延誤。

items.exampleEn: Prices here are radically different from those in the city.
items.exampleZh: 這裡的物價和城市裡的完全不同。

items.sentenceEn: Our plans changed radically after the meeting with the client.
items.sentenceZh: 和客戶開完會後，我們的計畫徹底改變了。

items.audioEn: Because of the breakdown of the coffee machine, we'll have tea at today's meeting.
items.audioZh: 因為咖啡機故障，今天開會我們喝茶。
options: There is no hot water today
The manager likes tea much better

items.sentenceEn: Job mobility is high in this field; people change companies every two years.
items.sentenceZh: 這一行的工作流動性很高，大家每兩年就換一家公司。

items.sentenceEn: The emergence of a new leader gave the team fresh energy.
items.sentenceZh: 新領導者的出現，給了團隊新的活力。

items.stemEn: Hot, dry weather can have ____ effects on rice farming.
items.stemZh: 炎熱乾燥的天氣可能對稻米耕作造成不利影響。

items.stemEn: Despite many problems, the team's hard work ____ in the end, and the project was a success.
items.stemZh: 儘管問題很多，團隊的努力最後還是勝出，專案成功了。

items.passageEn: Last winter, an outbreak of flu in our office forced the company to change how we work. Many staff stayed home, and there was a breakdown in communication between teams. Managers were reluctant at first, but common sense prevailed: they radically changed the rules and allowed people to work from home. The emergence of new online tools made this easier, and staff mobility improved, since people could work from anywhere. Some managers worried that sales would fall, but the change had no adverse effect on them. Today, most staff work from home two days a week.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，辦公室爆發流感，迫使公司改變工作方式。很多員工待在家裡，團隊之間的溝通也中斷了。經理們起初不太願意，但最後理性勝出：他們徹底改了規定，讓大家可以在家工作。新的線上工具興起讓這件事更容易，員工的工作地點也更有彈性，因為大家在哪裡都能工作。有些經理擔心業績會下滑，但這個改變對業績並沒有不利影響。如今，大部分員工每週有兩天在家工作。

questions.questionZh: 去年冬天公司發生了什麼事？
這個改變對業績有什麼影響？
options: 對業績沒有不利的影響

items.promptZh: 這項新規定對小店家造成了不利的影響。
referenceEn: The new rule has had an adverse effect on small shops.
This new rule had an adverse effect on small businesses.
rubricZh: adverse 放在名詞前（例如 an adverse effect）；寫 a negative effect 意思也對
時態用過去式或現在完成式都可以

items.promptZh: 她相信成為歌手是她的天命。
referenceEn: She believes that becoming a singer is her destiny.
She believes it is her destiny to become a singer.
rubricZh: destiny 指「天命、命運」（例如 is her destiny、her destiny to… 等）
「成為歌手」可寫，例如 becoming a singer、to become a singer 等
